role: development source-and-replay audit; not a novel agent method or training result
selection: Both already completed four-step neural arms B0 and B1_repaired of the same furnished pilot; no new traces chosen by outcome
source_expected: All source-deletable interior subsets, no unrestricted action edits or new poses
state_comparison: Exact equality of placed instances, registered templates, asset records, geometry hashes, frozen shell and frame metadata; history/call counters explicitly excluded
additional_measurement: New native FCL furniture-surface collision check at the no-deletion endpoint of each arm, compare original audit; no full-physics claim
invariant: Original first/last mutation protected. Missing other construction stages are not fabricated. Full CTC engine is not run. Original data stay read-only.
failure: Preserve output, command and traceback. No quality-driven retry, sample substitution or threshold adjustment.
training_gate: Endpoint preservation is not proof of task success; retain source failures as diagnostic negatives, not positive whole-room demonstrations
prediction: Endpoint and retained-feedback equivalence may differ, given the original native no-movement response; reported counts are empirical, not an admission quota
